# Nango

Nango provides a unified API to integrate with over 250 external APIs, offering pre-built and customizable integrations for various categories such as CRM, HR, and accounting systems.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/nango/.

## Actions

- **Get Provider Details** (read-only): Retrieve details for a specific provider.
- **List Connections** (read-only): List all connections.
- **List Connections** (read-only): List all connections without credentials.
- **List Providers** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all available providers.
- **Get Scripts Configuration** (read-only): Fetch the nango scripts configuration.
- **Trigger Nango Action**: Trigger nango workflow actions via api.
- **Trigger Sync**: Trigger a sync process manually.
